description:
### A Ceremony for the Healing of the Womb

We warmly invite you to a sacred ceremony dedicated to the healing and harmonization of feminine energy: the 13th Rite of the Munay-Ki.

This beautiful initiation, rooted in the wisdom of the Amazonian tradition, is passed from woman to woman, honoring the lineage of feminine strength and remembrance.

The womb is more than a physical space — it is a center of intuition, creativity, connection, and life force. Within it lives the ancient wisdom of the feminine. When we reconnect with this sacred space within our bodies, we reconnect with our primal source, our inner strength, and our authentic power as women.

Through this rite, we create a safe and supportive space where healing, release, and remembrance can unfold. Together, we honor our bodies, our stories, and the creative energy that flows through us.

This ceremony can be deeply moving and transformative — a gentle yet powerful invitation to come home to yourself.

### Program

10 am: Doors Open and arriving in the space  
11 am: Start of the program  
1 pm: snack/lunch break  
2 pm: womb Ritus  
4 pm: integration and flower ritual  
5 pm: end of program
